sources.summary: Polish architect Kuba Woźniczka has completed Studzienno 27, a series of four holiday cabins nestled in the woodlands of the Stołowe Mountains National Park. Looking to protect the natural landscape as much as possible, Woźniczka – a co-founder of studio KameleonLab – chose to "deliberately limit" the scheme's footprint.
